Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities.



Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and provide, and help deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you.

Rainmaker builds systems to increase precipitation and improve water availability. We combine atmospheric science, autonomous aircraft, radar and satellite observations, weather modeling, and novel sensing technologies.

Our software connects these systems, supports field operations, and turns each operation into data that improves the next one.

The role

 - Rainmaker is hiring a Software Engineer to own our production infrastructure and security.
   
   Your scope includes cloud infrastructure, deployments, observability, identity and access, secrets, vulnerability management, incident response, and recovery. You will build remote systems that work 24/7 and accommodate lost comms. Storms do not wait for business hours.

 -

 - Fast, thoughtful, autonomous, and opinionated.

 - Willing to relocate to El Segundo, CA.

 - Built and operated production systems. We care more about what you have shipped than your degree or years in the industry.

 - Deep familiarity with AWS and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Pulumi or Terraform.

 - Managed secrets and credential lifecycles in a fast-moving environment.

 - Designed or maintained zero-trust, WireGuard-based networks; we run almost everything on Tailscale.
